Parameter abs: int → int.

Axiom abs'def :
  ∀ (x:int),
  ((0%:Z ≤ x)%R → ((abs x) = x)) ∧ (¬ (0%:Z ≤ x)%R → ((abs x) = (-x)%R)).

Axiom Abs_le :
  ∀ (x:int) (y:int), ((abs x) ≤ y)%R ↔ ((-y)%R ≤ x)%R ∧ (x ≤ y)%R.

Axiom Abs_pos : ∀ (x:int), (0%:Z ≤ (abs x))%R.

Parameter div: int → int → int.

Parameter mod1: int → int → int.

Axiom Div_mod :
  ∀ (x:int) (y:int), ¬ (y = 0%:Z) →
  (x = ((y × (div x y))%R + (mod1 x y))%R).

Axiom Div_bound :
  ∀ (x:int) (y:int), (0%:Z ≤ x)%R ∧ (0%:Z < y)%R →
  (0%:Z ≤ (div x y))%R ∧ ((div x y) ≤ x)%R.

Axiom Mod_bound :
  ∀ (x:int) (y:int), ¬ (y = 0%:Z) →
  ((-(abs y))%R < (mod1 x y))%R ∧ ((mod1 x y) < (abs y))%R.

Axiom Div_sign_pos :
  ∀ (x:int) (y:int), (0%:Z ≤ x)%R ∧ (0%:Z < y)%R →
  (0%:Z ≤ (div x y))%R.

Axiom Div_sign_neg :
  ∀ (x:int) (y:int), (x ≤ 0%:Z)%R ∧ (0%:Z < y)%R →
  ((div x y) ≤ 0%:Z)%R.

Axiom Mod_sign_pos :
  ∀ (x:int) (y:int), (0%:Z ≤ x)%R ∧ ¬ (y = 0%:Z) →
  (0%:Z ≤ (mod1 x y))%R.

Axiom Mod_sign_neg :
  ∀ (x:int) (y:int), (x ≤ 0%:Z)%R ∧ ¬ (y = 0%:Z) →
  ((mod1 x y) ≤ 0%:Z)%R.

Axiom Rounds_toward_zero :
  ∀ (x:int) (y:int), ¬ (y = 0%:Z) →
  ((abs ((div x y) × y)%R) ≤ (abs x))%R.

Axiom Div_1 : ∀ (x:int), ((div x 1%:Z) = x).

Axiom Mod_1 : ∀ (x:int), ((mod1 x 1%:Z) = 0%:Z).

Axiom Div_inf :
  ∀ (x:int) (y:int), (0%:Z ≤ x)%R ∧ (x < y)%R → ((div x y) = 0%:Z).

Axiom Mod_inf :
  ∀ (x:int) (y:int), (0%:Z ≤ x)%R ∧ (x < y)%R → ((mod1 x y) = x).

Axiom Div_mult :
  ∀ (x:int) (y:int) (z:int),
  (0%:Z < x)%R ∧ (0%:Z ≤ y)%R ∧ (0%:Z ≤ z)%R →
  ((div ((x × y)%R + z)%R x) = (y + (div z x))%R).

Axiom Mod_mult :
  ∀ (x:int) (y:int) (z:int),
  (0%:Z < x)%R ∧ (0%:Z ≤ y)%R ∧ (0%:Z ≤ z)%R →
  ((mod1 ((x × y)%R + z)%R x) = (mod1 z x)).

Definition divides (d:int) (n:int) : Prop :=
  ((d = 0%:Z) → (n = 0%:Z)) ∧ (¬ (d = 0%:Z) → ((mod1 n d) = 0%:Z)).

Axiom divides'spec :
  ∀ (d:int) (n:int), divides d n ↔ (∃ q:int, (n = (q × d)%R)).

Axiom divides_refl : ∀ (n:int), divides n n.

Axiom divides_1_n : ∀ (n:int), divides 1%:Z n.

Axiom divides_0 : ∀ (n:int), divides n 0%:Z.

Axiom divides_left :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (c:int), divides a b → divides (c × a)%R (c × b)%R.

Axiom divides_right :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (c:int), divides a b → divides (a × c)%R (b × c)%R.

Axiom divides_oppr : ∀ (a:int) (b:int), divides a b → divides a (-b)%R.

Axiom divides_oppl : ∀ (a:int) (b:int), divides a b → divides (-a)%R b.

Axiom divides_oppr_rev :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int), divides (-a)%R b → divides a b.

Axiom divides_oppl_rev :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int), divides a (-b)%R → divides a b.

Axiom divides_plusr :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (c:int), divides a b → divides a c →
  divides a (b + c)%R.

Axiom divides_minusr :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (c:int), divides a b → divides a c →
  divides a (b - c)%R.

Axiom divides_multl :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (c:int), divides a b → divides a (c × b)%R.

Axiom divides_multr :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (c:int), divides a b → divides a (b × c)%R.

Axiom divides_factorl : ∀ (a:int) (b:int), divides a (b × a)%R.

Axiom divides_factorr : ∀ (a:int) (b:int), divides a (a × b)%R.

Axiom divides_n_1 :
  ∀ (n:int), divides n 1%:Z → (n = 1%:Z) ∨ (n = (-1%:Z)%Z).

Axiom divides_antisym :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int), divides a b → divides b a →
  (a = b) ∨ (a = (-b)%R).

Axiom divides_trans :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (c:int), divides a b → divides b c → divides a c.

Axiom divides_bounds :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int), divides a b → ¬ (b = 0%:Z) →
  ((abs a) ≤ (abs b))%R.

Axiom Div_unique :
  ∀ (x:int) (y:int) (q:int), (0%:Z < y)%R →
  ((q × y)%R ≤ x)%R ∧ (x < ((q × y)%R + y)%R)%R → ((x %/ y)%Z = q).

Axiom mod_divides_euclidean :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int), ¬ (b = 0%:Z) → ((a %% b)%Z = 0%:Z) → divides b a.

Axiom divides_mod_euclidean :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int), ¬ (b = 0%:Z) → divides b a → ((a %% b)%Z = 0%:Z).

Axiom mod_divides_computer :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int), ¬ (b = 0%:Z) → ((mod1 a b) = 0%:Z) → divides b a.

Axiom divides_mod_computer :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int), ¬ (b = 0%:Z) → divides b a → ((mod1 a b) = 0%:Z).

Definition even (n:int) : Prop := ∃ k:int, (n = (2%:Z × k)%R).

Definition odd (n:int) : Prop := ∃ k:int, (n = ((2%:Z × k)%R + 1%:Z)%R).

Axiom even_or_odd : ∀ (n:int), even n ∨ odd n.

Axiom even_not_odd : ∀ (n:int), even n → ¬ odd n.

Axiom odd_not_even : ∀ (n:int), odd n → ¬ even n.

Axiom even_odd : ∀ (n:int), even n → odd (n + 1%:Z)%R.

Axiom odd_even : ∀ (n:int), odd n → even (n + 1%:Z)%R.

Axiom even_even : ∀ (n:int), even n → even (n + 2%:Z)%R.

Axiom odd_odd : ∀ (n:int), odd n → odd (n + 2%:Z)%R.

Axiom even_2k : ∀ (k:int), even (2%:Z × k)%R.

Axiom odd_2k1 : ∀ (k:int), odd ((2%:Z × k)%R + 1%:Z)%R.

Axiom even_mod2 : ∀ (n:int), even n ↔ ((mod1 n 2%:Z) = 0%:Z).

Axiom even_divides : ∀ (a:int), even a ↔ divides 2%:Z a.

Axiom odd_divides : ∀ (a:int), odd a ↔ ¬ divides 2%:Z a.

Axiom Assoc2 :
  ∀ (x:int) (y:int) (z:int),
  ((gcdz (gcdz x y)%Z z)%Z = (gcdz x (gcdz y z)%Z)%Z).

Axiom Comm2 : ∀ (x:int) (y:int), ((gcdz x y)%Z = (gcdz y x)%Z).

Axiom gcd_mult :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (c:int), (0%:Z ≤ c)%R →
  ((gcdz (c × a)%R (c × b)%R)%Z = (c × (gcdz a b)%Z)%R).

Definition coprime (a:int) (b:int) : Prop := ((gcdz a b)%Z = 1%:Z).

Definition prime (p:int) : Prop :=
  (2%:Z ≤ p)%R ∧
  (∀ (n:int), (1%:Z < n)%R ∧ (n < p)%R → ¬ divides n p).

Axiom not_prime_1 : ¬ prime 1%:Z.

Axiom prime_2 : prime 2%:Z.

Axiom prime_3 : prime 3%:Z.

Axiom prime_divisors :
  ∀ (p:int), prime p → ∀ (d:int), divides d p →
  (d = 1%:Z) ∨ (d = (-1%:Z)%Z) ∨ (d = p) ∨ (d = (-p)%R).

Axiom small_divisors :
  ∀ (p:int), (2%:Z ≤ p)%R →
  (∀ (d:int), (2%:Z ≤ d)%R → prime d →
   (1%:Z < (d × d)%R)%R ∧ ((d × d)%R ≤ p)%R → ¬ divides d p) →
  prime p.

Axiom even_prime : ∀ (p:int), prime p → even p → (p = 2%:Z).

Axiom odd_prime : ∀ (p:int), prime p → (3%:Z ≤ p)%R → odd p.

Axiom prime_coprime :
  ∀ (p:int),
  prime p ↔
  (2%:Z ≤ p)%R ∧
  (∀ (n:int), (1%:Z ≤ n)%R ∧ (n < p)%R → coprime n p).

Axiom Gauss :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (c:int), divides a (b × c)%R ∧ coprime a b →
  divides a c.

Axiom Euclid :
  ∀ (p:int) (a:int) (b:int), prime p ∧ divides p (a × b)%R →
  divides p a ∨ divides p b.

Axiom gcd_coprime :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (c:int), coprime a b →
  ((gcdz a (b × c)%R)%Z = (gcdz a c)%Z).

Axiom Power_non_neg :
  ∀ (x:int) (y:int), (0%:Z ≤ x)%R ∧ (0%:Z ≤ y)%R →
  (0%:Z ≤ (x ^ y)%Z)%R.

Axiom Power_pos :
  ∀ (x:int) (y:int), (0%:Z < x)%R ∧ (0%:Z ≤ y)%R →
  (0%:Z < (x ^ y)%Z)%R.

Axiom Power_monotonic :
  ∀ (x:int) (n:int) (m:int),
  (0%:Z < x)%R ∧ (0%:Z ≤ n)%R ∧ (n ≤ m)%R → ((x ^ n)%Z ≤ (x ^ m)%Z)%R.

Parameter congr: int → int → int → Prop.

Axiom congr'def :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (m:int), ¬ (m = 0%:Z) →
  congr a b m ↔ ((a %% m)%Z = (b %% m)%Z).

Axiom unfold_congr :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (m:int), ¬ (m = 0%:Z) →
  congr a b m ↔ ((a %% m)%Z = (b %% m)%Z).

Axiom mod_x_2_01 :
  ∀ (x:int), ((x %% 2%:Z)%Z = 0%:Z) ∨ ((x %% 2%:Z)%Z = 1%:Z).

Axiom odd_mod2 : ∀ (n:int), odd n ↔ ((n %% 2%:Z)%Z = 1%:Z).

Axiom mod_scaleRL :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (k:int) (m:int), ¬ (m = 0%:Z) → ¬ (k = 0%:Z) →
  coprime k m → congr (a × k)%R (b × k)%R m → congr a b m.

Axiom mod_scaleLR :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (k:int) (m:int), ¬ (m = 0%:Z) → congr a b m →
  congr (a × k)%R (b × k)%R m.

Axiom mod_sub :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (x:int) (y:int) (m:int), ¬ (m = 0%:Z) →
  congr a x m → congr b y m → congr (a - b)%R (x - y)%R m.

Axiom mod_add :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (x:int) (y:int) (m:int), ¬ (m = 0%:Z) →
  congr a x m → congr b y m → congr (a + b)%R (x + y)%R m.

Axiom mod_div :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (k:int) (m:int), ¬ (m = 0%:Z) → ¬ (k = 0%:Z) →
  congr a b m → divides k a → divides k b → coprime k m →
  congr (a %/ k)%Z (b %/ k)%Z m.

Axiom eq_congr :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (m:int), ¬ (m = 0%:Z) → (a = b) → congr a b m.

Axiom mod_mult :
  ∀ (x:int) (y:int) (z:int), (0%:Z < x)%R → congr ((x × y)%R + z)%R z x.

Axiom congr_trans :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (c:int) (m:int), ¬ (m = 0%:Z) → congr a b m →
  congr b c m → congr a c m.

Axiom congr_add_m :
  ∀ (a:int) (m:int), (0%:Z < m)%R → congr a (a + m)%R m.

Axiom mod_idem :
  ∀ (a:int) (m:int), ¬ (m = 0%:Z) → (((a %% m)%Z %% m)%Z = (a %% m)%Z).

Axiom congr_mod :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (m:int), (0%:Z < m)%R → congr a b m →
  congr a (b + m)%R m.

Axiom congr_mult :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (c:int) (d:int) (m:int), ¬ (m = 0%:Z) →
  congr a b m → congr c (d × b)%R m → congr c (d × a)%R m.

Axiom congr_mod_idem :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (m:int), ¬ (m = 0%:Z) →
  congr (a %% m)%Z b m ↔ congr a b m.

Axiom congr_rewr :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (c:int) (k:int) (m:int), ¬ (m = 0%:Z) →
  ¬ (k = 0%:Z) → congr a b m → congr (a × k)%R c m → congr (b × k)%R c m.

Parameter div_mod: int → int → int.

Axiom div_mod'def :
  ∀ (x:int) (m:int), (0%:Z < m)%R → ((m %% 2%:Z)%Z = 1%:Z) →
  ((div_mod x m) = (x × ((m + 1%:Z)%R %/ 2%:Z)%Z)%R).

Axiom div_mod'spec :
  ∀ (x:int) (m:int), (0%:Z < m)%R → ((m %% 2%:Z)%Z = 1%:Z) →
  congr x (2%:Z × (div_mod x m))%R m.

Axiom odd_sub_div :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int), odd a → odd b → divides 2%:Z (a - b)%R.

Axiom mod21_sub_div :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int), ((a %% 2%:Z)%Z = 1%:Z) → ((b %% 2%:Z)%Z = 1%:Z) →
  divides 2%:Z (a - b)%R.

Axiom div_comp :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (k:int), divides b a → divides k (a %/ b)%Z →
  divides (b × k)%R a.

Axiom div_divides :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int), ¬ (b = 0%:Z) → divides b a →
  ((b × (a %/ b)%Z)%R = a).

Axiom divides_factors :
  ∀ (a:int) (k1:int) (k2:int), ¬ (k1 = 0%:Z) → divides k1 a →
  divides k2 (a %/ k1)%Z → divides (k2 × k1)%R a.

Axiom divides_sub :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (k:int), divides k a → divides k b →
  divides k (a - b)%R.

Axiom divides_factorK :
  ∀ (a:int) (k:int), ¬ (k = 0%:Z) → (((a × k)%R %/ k)%Z = a).

Axiom divides_add :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (k:int), divides k a → divides k b →
  divides k (a + b)%R.

Axiom dividesP :
  ∀ (k:int) (a:int), divides k a ↔ (∃ q:int, (a = (q × k)%R)).

Axiom div_sub :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (k:int), ¬ (k = 0%:Z) → divides k a →
  divides k b → (((a - b)%R %/ k)%Z = ((a %/ k)%Z - (b %/ k)%Z)%R).

Axiom div_add :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (k:int), ¬ (k = 0%:Z) → divides k a →
  divides k b → (((a + b)%R %/ k)%Z = ((a %/ k)%Z + (b %/ k)%Z)%R).

Axiom div_mult :
  ∀ (x:int) (y:int), (0%:Z < x)%R ∧ (0%:Z ≤ y)%R →
  (((x × y)%R %/ x)%Z = y).

Axiom div_mult_factor_pos :
  ∀ (x:int) (y:int) (z:int), ¬ (y = 0%:Z) → (0%:Z < z)%R →
  (((x × z)%R %/ (y × z)%R)%Z = (x %/ y)%Z).

Axiom div_factor_divisor :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int), ¬ (b = 0%:Z) → (((a × b)%R %/ b)%Z = a).

Axiom div_negH :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int), ¬ (b = 0%:Z) → divides b a →
  ((-(a %/ b)%Z)%R = ((-a)%R %/ b)%Z).

Axiom div_negL :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int), ¬ (b = 0%:Z) → divides b a →
  ((-(a %/ b)%Z)%R = (a %/ (-b)%R)%Z).

Axiom div_mult_factor_neg :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (k:int), ¬ (b = 0%:Z) → (k < 0%:Z)%R →
  divides b a → (((a × k)%R %/ (b × k)%R)%Z = (a %/ b)%Z).

Axiom divides_multl1 :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (c:int), divides (a × b)%R c → divides a c.

Axiom divides_multr1 :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (c:int), divides (a × b)%R c → divides b c.

Axiom split_factor_divisor :
  ∀ (a:int) (x:int) (y:int), ¬ (x = 0%:Z) → ¬ (y = 0%:Z) →
  divides (x × y)%R a → ((a %/ (x × y)%R)%Z = ((a %/ y)%Z %/ x)%Z).

Axiom div_factors_comm :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (k:int), ¬ (b = 0%:Z) → divides b a →
  ((k × (a %/ b)%Z)%R = ((k × a)%R %/ b)%Z).

Axiom div_lt_mono :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (k:int), ¬ (b = 0%:Z) → (0%:Z < k)%R →
  divides k a → divides k b → (b < a)%R → ((b %/ k)%Z < (a %/ k)%Z)%R.

Axiom div_gt :
  ∀ (x:int) (y:int), ¬ (y = 0%:Z) → (0%:Z ≤ x)%R ∧ (x < y)%R →
  ((x %/ y)%Z = 0%:Z).

Axiom gt_div :
  ∀ (x:int) (y:int) (k:int), (0%:Z ≤ y)%R ∧ (y ≤ x)%R →
  (0%:Z < k)%R → ((y %/ k)%Z ≤ (x %/ k)%Z)%R.

Axiom abs_multC :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int), ((abs (a × b)%R) = ((abs a) × (abs b))%R).

Axiom div_neg :
  ∀ (a:int) (k:int), (0%:Z < k)%R →
  ((a %/ k)%Z ≤ (((abs a) %/ k)%Z + 1%:Z)%R)%R.

Axiom abs_div :
  ∀ (a:int) (k:int), ¬ (k = 0%:Z) → (0%:Z < k)%R → divides k a →
  ((abs (a %/ k)%Z) ≤ (((abs a) %/ k)%Z + 1%:Z)%R)%R.

Axiom abs_div_le :
  ∀ (a:int) (k:int), ¬ (k = 0%:Z) → (0%:Z < k)%R → divides k a →
  ((abs (a %/ k)%Z) ≤ ((abs a) %/ k)%Z)%R.

Axiom abs_div_strong :
  ∀ (a:int) (k:int), (0%:Z < k)%R → divides k a →
  ((abs (a %/ k)%Z) = ((abs a) %/ k)%Z).

Axiom abs_div2 :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (k:int), ¬ (k = 0%:Z) → (0%:Z < k)%R →
  divides k a → divides k b →
  ((abs ((a + b)%R %/ k)%Z) ≤ ((((abs a) + (abs b))%R %/ k)%Z + 1%:Z)%R)%R.

Axiom abs_div3 :
  ∀ (a:int) (k:int), (0%:Z < k)%R → divides k a →
  ((abs (a %/ k)%Z) = ((abs a) %/ k)%Z).

Axiom abs_add :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int), ((abs (a + b)%R) ≤ ((abs a) + (abs b))%R)%R.

Axiom abs_sub_bounds_gt'0 :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (k:int), (0%:Z ≤ a)%R → (b < 0%:Z)%R →
  ((abs (a - b)%R) < k)%R → (a ≤ k)%R.

Axiom abs_sub_bounds_gt :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (k:int), (0%:Z ≤ a)%R → (b < 0%:Z)%R →
  ((abs (a - b)%R) < k)%R → ((-k)%R < b)%R.

Axiom abs_sub_bounds_geq'0 :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (k:int), (0%:Z ≤ a)%R → (b < 0%:Z)%R →
  ((abs (a - b)%R) ≤ k)%R → (a ≤ k)%R.

Axiom abs_sub_bounds_geq :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (k:int), (0%:Z ≤ a)%R → (b < 0%:Z)%R →
  ((abs (a - b)%R) ≤ k)%R → ((-k)%R ≤ b)%R.

Axiom div_abs_add_leq :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (f0:int) (g0:int) (k:int) (j:int),
  ((abs a) < k)%R → ((abs b) < k)%R → (0%:Z < j)%R →

Parameter approx: int → int → int → int.

Axiom approx'def :
  ∀ (x:int) (n:int) (k:int), (1%:Z < k)%R →

  let factor := (2%:Z ^ (k - 1%:Z)%R)%Z in

Axiom unfold_approx :

Axiom bound_dS1 :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (f0:int) (g0:int) (f1:int) (g1:int) (n:int)
    (k:int) (j:int),
  (0%:Z ≤ j)%R → (1%:Z < k)%R → (0%:Z ≤ ((n - k)%R - 1%:Z)%R)%R →
  divides (2%:Z ^ j)%Z (updated_x a b f0 g0) →
  divides (2%:Z ^ j)%Z (updated_x (approx a n k) (approx b n k) f0 g0) →
  divides (2%:Z ^ j)%Z (updated_x a b f1 g1) →
  divides (2%:Z ^ j)%Z (updated_x (approx a n k) (approx b n k) f1 g1) →
  (((abs f0) + (abs g0))%R ≤ (2%:Z ^ j)%Z)%R →
  (((abs f1) + (abs g1))%R ≤ (2%:Z ^ j)%Z)%R → ((2%:Z × k)%R ≤ n)%R →
  ¬ is_halving' (xt (approx a n k) (approx b n k) f0 g0 j) →
  is_divergent2 a b j (xt (approx a n k) (approx b n k) f0 g0 j)
  (xt (approx a n k) (approx b n k) f1 g1 j) f0 g0 f1 g1 →
  ((abs ((xt a b f1 g1 j) - (xt a b f0 g0 j))%R) ≤ (2%:Z ^ (n - k)%R)%Z)%R.

Parameter regular': int → int → int → int → int → int → int → Prop.

Axiom regular''def :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (f0:int) (g0:int) (f1:int) (g1:int) (t:int),
  (0%:Z ≤ t)%R →
  regular' a b f0 g0 f1 g1 t ↔
  ((((len (xt a b f0 g0 t)) + (len (xt a b f1 g1 t)))%R + t)%R ≤
   ((len a) + (len b))%R)%R.

Axiom unfold_regular' :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (f0:int) (g0:int) (f1:int) (g1:int) (t:int),
  (0%:Z ≤ t)%R →

Parameter good':
  int → int → int → int → int → int → int → int → Prop.

Axiom good''def :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (f0:int) (g0:int) (f1:int) (g1:int) (t:int) (k:int),
  (0%:Z ≤ t)%R → (t ≤ (k - 1%:Z)%R)%R →
  good' a b f0 g0 f1 g1 t k ↔
  ((((len (xt a b f0 g0 t)) + (len (xt a b f1 g1 t)))%R + (k - 1%:Z)%R)%R ≤
   ((len a) + (len b))%R)%R.

Axiom unfold_good' :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (f0:int) (g0:int) (f1:int) (g1:int) (t:int) (k:int),
  (0%:Z ≤ t)%R → (t ≤ (k - 1%:Z)%R)%R →
  good' a b f0 g0 f1 g1 t k ↔
  ((((len (xt a b f0 g0 t)) + (len (xt a b f1 g1 t)))%R + (k - 1%:Z)%R)%R ≤
   ((len a) + (len b))%R)%R.

Axiom good'_regular' :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (f0:int) (g0:int) (f1:int) (g1:int) (t:int) (k:int),
  (0%:Z ≤ t)%R ∧ (t ≤ (k - 1%:Z)%R)%R → good' a b f0 g0 f1 g1 t k →
  regular' a b f0 g0 f1 g1 t.

Parameter maxt: int → int → int → int → int → int → int → int.

Axiom maxt'def :

Parameter m: int.

Axiom m_gt3 : (3%:Z ≤ m)%R.

Parameter n: t → int.

Axiom t'invariant :

Parameter to_int: t → int.

Axiom to_int'spec : ∀ (n1:t), ((to_int n1) = (n n1)).

Definition congr_m (x:int) (y:int) : Prop :=
  (x = y) ∨ (x = (y + m)%R) ∨ (y = (x + m)%R).

Parameter of_int: int → t.

Axiom of_int'spec :
  ∀ (x:int), (0%:Z ≤ x)%R ∧ (x < m)%R → (x = (to_int (of_int x))).

Parameter sub: t → t → t.

Axiom sub'spec :
  ∀ (x:t) (y:t), congr_m ((to_int x) - (to_int y))%R (to_int (sub x y)).

Axiom x_mod : ∀ (x:t), ((to_int x) = ((to_int x) %% m)%Z).

Parameter mont_div_mod: t → t.

Axiom mont_div_mod'spec :
  ∀ (x:t), ((m %% 2%:Z)%Z = 1%:Z) →
  (((to_int x) %% m)%Z = ((2%:Z × (to_int (mont_div_mod x)))%R %% m)%Z).

Axiom congr_m_congr : ∀ (a:int) (b:int), congr_m a b → congr a b m.

Axiom congr_even :
  ∀ (a:int) (y:int) (bu:t), congr a ((to_int bu) × y)%R m →
  coprime 2%:Z m → ((a %% 2%:Z)%Z = 0%:Z) →
  congr (a %/ 2%:Z)%Z ((to_int (mont_div_mod bu)) × y)%R m.

Axiom congr_barfg0_even :
  ∀ (f0:int) (bf0:int) (j:int),
  congr f0 ((2%:Z ^ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%Z × bf0)%R m → (0%:Z ≤ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%R →
  congr f0 ((2%:Z ^ ((j + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R)%Z × (div_mod bf0 m))%R m.

Axiom congr_barfg1_even :
  ∀ (f1:int) (bf1:int) (j:int),
  congr f1 ((2%:Z ^ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%Z × bf1)%R m → (0%:Z ≤ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%R →
  congr (2%:Z × f1)%R ((2%:Z ^ ((j + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R)%Z × bf1)%R m.

Axiom congr_mut_uf0 :
  ∀ (u:t) (bu:t) (v:t) (k:int) (f0:int) (g0:int) (i:int) (j:int),
  congr (updated_x (to_int u) (to_int v) f0 g0)
  ((2%:Z ^ ((((k - 1%:Z)%R × (i - 1%:Z)%R)%R + j)%R - 1%:Z)%R)%Z ×
   (to_int bu))%R
  m → (0%:Z ≤ (i - 1%:Z)%R)%R → (0%:Z ≤ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%R →
  (0%:Z ≤ (k - 1%:Z)%R)%R →
  congr (updated_x (to_int u) (to_int v) f0 g0)
  ((2%:Z ^ ((((k - 1%:Z)%R × (i - 1%:Z)%R)%R + (j + 1%:Z)%R)%R - 1%:Z)%R)%Z ×
   (to_int (mont_div_mod bu)))%R
  m.

Axiom congr_mut_uf1 :
  ∀ (u:t) (v:t) (bv:t) (k:int) (f1:int) (g1:int) (i:int) (j:int),
  (0%:Z ≤ (i - 1%:Z)%R)%R → (0%:Z ≤ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%R →
  (0%:Z ≤ (k - 1%:Z)%R)%R →
  congr (updated_x (to_int u) (to_int v) f1 g1)
  ((2%:Z ^ ((((k - 1%:Z)%R × (i - 1%:Z)%R)%R + j)%R - 1%:Z)%R)%Z ×
   (to_int bv))%R
  m →
  congr (updated_x (to_int u) (to_int v) (2%:Z × f1)%R (2%:Z × g1)%R)
  ((2%:Z ^ ((((k - 1%:Z)%R × (i - 1%:Z)%R)%R + (j + 1%:Z)%R)%R - 1%:Z)%R)%Z ×
   (to_int bv))%R
  m.

Axiom congr_mut_odd :
  ∀ (u:t) (v:t) (bu:t) (bv:t) (f0:int) (f1:int) (g0:int) (g1:int)
    (i:int) (j:int) (k:int),
  (0%:Z ≤ (i - 1%:Z)%R)%R → (0%:Z ≤ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%R →
  (0%:Z ≤ (k - 1%:Z)%R)%R →
  congr (updated_x (to_int u) (to_int v) f0 g0)
  ((2%:Z ^ ((((k - 1%:Z)%R × (i - 1%:Z)%R)%R + j)%R - 1%:Z)%R)%Z ×
   (to_int bu))%R
  m →
  congr (updated_x (to_int u) (to_int v) f1 g1)
  ((2%:Z ^ ((((k - 1%:Z)%R × (i - 1%:Z)%R)%R + j)%R - 1%:Z)%R)%Z ×
   (to_int bv))%R
  m →
  congr (updated_x (to_int u) (to_int v) (f0 - f1)%R (g0 - g1)%R)
  ((2%:Z ^ ((((k - 1%:Z)%R × (i - 1%:Z)%R)%R + (j + 1%:Z)%R)%R - 1%:Z)%R)%Z ×
   (to_int (mont_div_mod (sub bu bv))))%R
  m.

Axiom gcd_odd_lt :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int), ((b %% 2%:Z)%Z = 1%:Z) → ((a %% 2%:Z)%Z = 1%:Z) →
  ((gcdz a b)%Z = (gcdz ((a - b)%R %/ 2%:Z)%Z b)%Z).

Axiom inv_bezout_odd_u :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (y:int) (bu:t) (bv:t), ((b %% 2%:Z)%Z = 1%:Z) →
  ((a %% 2%:Z)%Z = 1%:Z) → congr a ((to_int bu) × y)%R m →
  congr b ((to_int bv) × y)%R m →
  congr ((a - b)%R %/ 2%:Z)%Z ((to_int (mont_div_mod (sub bu bv))) × y)%R m.

Axiom inv_bezout_odd_u' :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (j:int) (y:int) (f0:int) (g0:int) (f1:int) (g1:int)
    (bu:t) (bv:t),
  (0%:Z ≤ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%R →
  divides (2%:Z ^ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%Z (updated_x a b f0 g0) →
  divides (2%:Z ^ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%Z (updated_x a b f1 g1) →
  (((xt a b f1 g1 (j - 1%:Z)%R) %% 2%:Z)%Z = 1%:Z) →
  (((xt a b (2%:Z × f0)%R (2%:Z × g0)%R ((j + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R) %% 2%:Z)%Z =
   1%:Z) →
  congr (xt a b f0 g0 (j - 1%:Z)%R) ((to_int bu) × y)%R m →
  congr (xt a b f1 g1 (j - 1%:Z)%R) ((to_int bv) × y)%R m →
  congr (xt a b (f1 - f0)%R (g1 - g0)%R ((j + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R)
  ((to_int (mont_div_mod (sub bv bu))) × y)%R m.

Axiom pres_f0_odd :
  ∀ (f0:int) (f1:int) (j:int) (bf0:int) (bf1:int),
  congr f0 ((2%:Z ^ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%Z × bf0)%R m →
  congr f1 ((2%:Z ^ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%Z × bf1)%R m → (0%:Z ≤ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%R →
  congr (f0 - f1)%R
  ((2%:Z ^ ((j + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R)%Z × (div_mod (bf0 - bf1)%R m))%R m.

Axiom inner_gcd_even :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (f0:int) (g0:int) (f1:int) (g1:int) (j:int),
  ((gcdz a b)%Z =
   (gcdz (xt a b f0 g0 (j - 1%:Z)%R) (xt a b f1 g1 (j - 1%:Z)%R))%Z) →
  (0%:Z ≤ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%R →
  divides (2%:Z ^ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%Z (updated_x a b f0 g0) →
  (((xt a b f0 g0 (j - 1%:Z)%R) %% 2%:Z)%Z = 0%:Z) →
  (((xt a b f1 g1 (j - 1%:Z)%R) %% 2%:Z)%Z = 1%:Z) →
  ((gcdz a b)%Z =
   (gcdz (xt a b f0 g0 ((j + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R)
    (xt a b (2%:Z × f1)%R (2%:Z × g1)%R ((j + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R))%Z).

Axiom gcd_inner_odd :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (f0:int) (g0:int) (f1:int) (g1:int) (j:int) (k:int),
  divides (2%:Z ^ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%Z (updated_x a b f0 g0) →
  divides (2%:Z ^ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%Z (updated_x a b f1 g1) →
  (0%:Z ≤ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%R →
  (((xt a b f1 g1 (j - 1%:Z)%R) %% 2%:Z)%Z = 1%:Z) →
  congr (xt a b f0 g0 (j - 1%:Z)%R)
  (xt (approx a (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R)) k)
   (approx b (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R)) k) f0 g0 (j - 1%:Z)%R)
  2%:Z →
  ¬ (((xt (approx a (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R)) k)
       (approx b (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R)) k) f0 g0
       (j - 1%:Z)%R)
      %% 2%:Z)%Z
     = 0%:Z) →
  ((gcdz (xt a b f0 g0 (j - 1%:Z)%R) (xt a b f1 g1 (j - 1%:Z)%R))%Z =
   (gcdz (xt a b (f0 - f1)%R (g0 - g1)%R ((j + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R)
    (xt a b (2%:Z × f1)%R (2%:Z × g1)%R ((j + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R))%Z).

Axiom gcd_inner_odd_swap :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (f0:int) (g0:int) (f1:int) (g1:int) (j:int) (k:int),
  divides (2%:Z ^ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%Z (updated_x a b f0 g0) →
  divides (2%:Z ^ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%Z (updated_x a b f1 g1) →
  (0%:Z ≤ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%R →
  (((xt a b f1 g1 (j - 1%:Z)%R) %% 2%:Z)%Z = 1%:Z) →
  congr (xt a b f0 g0 (j - 1%:Z)%R)
  (xt (approx a (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R)) k)
   (approx b (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R)) k) f0 g0 (j - 1%:Z)%R)
  2%:Z →
  ¬ (((xt (approx a (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R)) k)
       (approx b (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R)) k) f0 g0
       (j - 1%:Z)%R)
      %% 2%:Z)%Z
     = 0%:Z) →
  ((gcdz (xt a b f1 g1 (j - 1%:Z)%R) (xt a b f0 g0 (j - 1%:Z)%R))%Z =
   (gcdz (xt a b (f0 - f1)%R (g0 - g1)%R ((j + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R)
    (xt a b (2%:Z × f1)%R (2%:Z × g1)%R ((j + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R))%Z).

Axiom inner_bound_at_even :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (f0:int) (g0:int) (j:int) (m1:int),
  (0%:Z ≤ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%R → (0%:Z ≤ b)%R → (b < (2%:Z ^ (len m1))%Z)%R →
  ((xt a b f0 g0 (j - 1%:Z)%R) < (2%:Z ^ (len m1))%Z)%R →
  divides (2%:Z ^ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%Z (updated_x a b f0 g0) →
  divides 2%:Z ((updated_x a b f0 g0) %/ (2%:Z ^ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%Z)%Z →
  ((xt a b f0 g0 ((j + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R) < (2%:Z ^ (len m1))%Z)%R.

Axiom congr_even_bu :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (f0:int) (g0:int) (j:int) (ba:int) (y:int) (bu:t),

Axiom exact_divs_even_f1 :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (f1:int) (g1:int) (j:int),
  (0%:Z ≤ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%R →

Axiom exact_divs_even_f0 :
  ∀ (a:int) (b:int) (f0:int) (g0:int) (j:int),

Axiom not_div_dec_len_even :
  ∀ (y:int) (a:int) (b:int) (f0:int) (g0:int) (f1:int) (g1:int)
    (i:int) (j:int) (k:int) (not_div:bool),
  (0%:Z ≤ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%R → (not_div = true) →

  ((((((len (xt a b f0 g0 (j - 1%:Z)%R)) +

      + ((k - 1%:Z)%R × (i - 1%:Z)%R)%R)%R

    - 1%:Z)%R

  divides (2%:Z ^ (j - 1%:Z)%R)%Z (updated_x a b f0 g0) →

  (xt (approx a (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R)) k)
   (approx b (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R)) k) f0 g0 (j - 1%:Z)%R)
  2%:Z →
  (((xt (approx a (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R)) k)
     (approx b (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R)) k) f0 g0
     (j - 1%:Z)%R)
    %% 2%:Z)%Z
   = 0%:Z) →
  ((xt a b f0 g0 ((j + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R) = 0%:Z) ∨
  ((((((len (xt a b f0 g0 ((j + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R)) +
       (len (xt a b (2%:Z × f1)%R (2%:Z × g1)%R ((j + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R)))%R
      + ((k - 1%:Z)%R × (i - 1%:Z)%R)%R)%R
     + (j + 1%:Z)%R)%R
    - 1%:Z)%R
   ≤ ((len y) + (len m))%R)%R.

Parameter update_divergence_status: iter_vars → iter_vars.

Axiom update_divergence_status'def :
  ∀ (vars:iter_vars), (0%:Z ≤ ((j' vars) - 1%:Z)%R)%R →
  (is_divergent vars →
   (has_diverged vars → ((update_divergence_status vars) = vars)) ∧
   (¬ has_diverged vars →
    ((update_divergence_status vars) = (set_this_iter (set_divergence vars))))) ∧
  (¬ is_divergent vars → ((update_divergence_status vars) = vars)).

Axiom update_not_divergent :
  ∀ (vars:iter_vars), (0%:Z ≤ ((j' vars) - 1%:Z)%R)%R →
  ¬ is_divergent vars → ((update_divergence_status vars) = vars).

Axiom update_divergent_has :

Axiom update_divergent_not_has :

  ((update_divergence_status vars) = (set_this_iter (set_divergence vars))).

Definition odd_not_swap (vars:iter_vars) : iter_vars :=
  iter_vars'mk (a' vars) (b' vars) (k' vars) (n' vars) (j' vars)
  (((ba' vars) - (bb' vars))%R %/ 2%:Z)%Z (bb' vars)

  (2%:Z × (f1' vars))%R (2%:Z × (g1' vars))%R
  (div_mod ((bf0' vars) - (bf1' vars))%R m)
  (div_mod ((bg0' vars) - (bg1' vars))%R m) (bf1' vars) (bg1' vars)
  (mont_div_mod (sub (bu' vars) (bv' vars))) (bv' vars) (this_iter' vars)
  (divergence' vars).

      ((Init.Datatypes.orb (Init.Datatypes.andb true false)

      ((Init.Datatypes.orb (Init.Datatypes.andb true false)
        (Init.Datatypes.andb false false))

  (¬ (0%:Z ≤ x)%R →
   ((0%:Z ≤ y)%R →
    ((x < 0%:Z)%R →
     ((y < 0%:Z)%R →
      ((Init.Datatypes.orb (Init.Datatypes.andb false true)

     ((y < 0%:Z)%R →

Parameter odd_step: iter_vars → iter_vars.

Axiom odd_step'def :
  ∀ (vars:iter_vars), (0%:Z ≤ ((j' vars) - 1%:Z)%R)%R →
  let vars' := update_divergence_status vars in
  (is_ba_lt_bb vars' → ((odd_step vars) = (odd_not_swap (swap vars')))) ∧
  (¬ is_ba_lt_bb vars' → ((odd_step vars) = (odd_not_swap vars'))).

Axiom update_swap :
  ∀ (vars:iter_vars), (0%:Z ≤ ((j' vars) - 1%:Z)%R)%R →
  is_ba_lt_bb vars ↔ is_ba_lt_bb (update_divergence_status vars).

Axiom odd_step_lt :
  ∀ (vars:iter_vars), (0%:Z ≤ ((j' vars) - 1%:Z)%R)%R →
  is_ba_lt_bb vars →
  ((odd_step vars) = (odd_not_swap (swap (update_divergence_status vars)))).

Axiom odd_step_not_lt :
  ∀ (vars:iter_vars), (0%:Z ≤ ((j' vars) - 1%:Z)%R)%R →
  ¬ is_ba_lt_bb vars →
  ((odd_step vars) = (odd_not_swap (update_divergence_status vars))).

Axiom this_iter_lt :
  ∀ (vars:iter_vars),
  is_ba_lt_bb vars ↔ is_ba_lt_bb (unset_this_iter vars).

  divides (2%:Z ^ (((k - 1%:Z)%R + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R)%Z (updated_x a b f1 g1).

Axiom factor_bahatt :
  divides (2%:Z ^ (((k - 1%:Z)%R + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R)%Z
  (updated_x (approx a (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R)) k)
   (approx b (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R)) k) f0 g0).

Axiom factor_bbhatt :
  divides (2%:Z ^ (((k - 1%:Z)%R + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R)%Z
  (updated_x (approx a (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R)) k)
   (approx b (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R)) k) f1 g1).

Axiom bat_is_ba :
  ((xt (approx a (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R)) k)
    (approx b (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R)) k) f0 g0
    (((k - 1%:Z)%R + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R)
   = ba).

Axiom bbt_is_bb :
  ((xt (approx a (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R)) k)
    (approx b (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R)) k) f1 g1
    (((k - 1%:Z)%R + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R)
   = bb).

Axiom bd_pos :
  ¬ (divergence = true) →
  (0%:Z ≤ (xt a b f0 g0 (((k - 1%:Z)%R + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R))%R.

Axiom bd_pos1 :
  ¬ (divergence = true) →
  (0%:Z ≤ (xt a b f1 g1 (((k - 1%:Z)%R + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R))%R.

Axiom i_geq_11 : (0%:Z ≤ (i - 1%:Z)%R)%R.

Axiom cases_ab :
  (0%:Z ≤ (xt a b f0 g0 (((k - 1%:Z)%R + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R))%R ∧
  (0%:Z ≤ (xt a b f1 g1 (((k - 1%:Z)%R + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R))%R ∨
  (0%:Z ≤ (xt a b f0 g0 (((k - 1%:Z)%R + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R))%R ∧
  ((xt a b f1 g1 (((k - 1%:Z)%R + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R) < 0%:Z)%R ∨
  ((xt a b f0 g0 (((k - 1%:Z)%R + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R) < 0%:Z)%R ∧
  (0%:Z ≤ (xt a b f1 g1 (((k - 1%:Z)%R + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R))%R.

Axiom is_done_inv : ((a' vars) = 0%:Z) → ((a_t vars) = 0%:Z).

Axiom iter_a : ((a' vars) = a).

Axiom iter_b : ((b' vars) = b).

Axiom iter_k : ((k' vars) = k).

Axiom iter_n : ((n' vars) = (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R))).

Axiom iter_vars1 :
  (vars =
   (iter (((k - 1%:Z)%R + 1%:Z)%R - 1%:Z)%R
    (fun (y0:iter_vars) ⇒ inner_iter_fun y0)
    (iter_vars'mk a b k (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R)) 1%:Z
     (approx a (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R)) k)
     (approx b (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R)) k) 1%:Z 0%:Z 0%:Z
     1%:Z 1%:Z 0%:Z 0%:Z 1%:Z bu bv false false))).

Axiom H6 : ¬ ((max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R)) = (2%:Z × k)%R).

Axiom H7 : ¬ ((a_t vars) = 0%:Z).

Require Gcd.pornin_gcd.

Lemma neqP : ∀ {T : eqType} {x y : T}, reflect (x ≠ y) ((x != y)).
Proof.
move⇒ T x y.
apply /(iffP idP).
- move⇒ /negPf/eqP//.
- move⇒ neq; apply /negP⇒ /eqP//.
Qed.

Lemma k_to_nat : ∃ (kn : nat), Posz kn = k.
Proof. by move: Requires2; case: k⇒ // kn _; ∃ kn. Qed.

Definition N := (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%:Z × k)%R)).

Lemma abs_aligns (x : int) : abs x = absz x.
Proof. by rewrite (pornin_gcd.eq_abs abs'def). Qed.

Lemma align1 : (∀ x : int, len x = len `|x|%N).
Proof. by move⇒ x; move: (len_abs x); rewrite abs_aligns. Qed.

Lemma align2 : (∀ x : int, len x = len (- x)).
Proof. by move⇒ x; rewrite len_neg. Qed.

Lemma align3 : (∀ x : int, 0%Z ≤ len x).
Proof. by apply len'spec. Qed.

Lemma align4 : (∀ x : int, `|x|%N%:Z < 2%Z ^ len x).
Proof. by move⇒ x; rewrite -abs_aligns; apply len'spec'1. Qed.

Lemma align5 : (∀ x y : int, 0%Z ≤ y ∧ y ≤ x → len y ≤ len x).
Proof. exact: len_geq. Qed.

Lemma align6 : (∀ x : int, 0%Z ≤ x → (x %/ 2%Z ^ len x)%Z = 0%Z).
Proof. exact: div_len. Qed.

Lemma align7 : (∀ x : int, 1%Z < x → len x = len (x %/ 2%Z)%Z + 1%Z).
Proof. exact: len_div2. Qed.

Lemma align8 : (∀ k : int, 0%Z ≤ k → len (2%Z ^ k) = k + 1%Z).
Proof. exact: len_power2. Qed.

Lemma align9 : (∀ x y : int, 0%Z ≤ y ∧ y ≤ x → len (x - y) ≤ len x).
Proof. exact: len_sub. Qed.

Lemma align10 : (∀ x k : int, 0%Z ≤ k → `|x|%N%:Z < 2%Z ^ k → len x ≤ k).
Proof. by move⇒ x y; move: (@len'spec'0 x y); rewrite abs_aligns. Qed.

Lemma align11 : (∀ x : int, 0%Z < x → len x + 1%Z = len (2%Z × x)).
Proof. exact: len_mul2. Qed.

Lemma align12 : (∀ x y k : int, 0%Z ≤ y ∧ y ≤ x → 0%Z < k → len (y %/ k)%Z ≤ len (x %/ k)%Z).
Proof. exact: len_ge_div. Qed.

Lemma align13 : (∀ k : int, 0%Z ≤ k → len (- 2%Z ^ k) = k + 1%Z).
Proof. exact: len_pow2_neg. Qed.

Lemma align14 : (∀ x k : int, 1%Z ≤ k → 0%Z ≤ x ∧ x < 2%Z ^ k → len x ≤ k).
Proof. exact: len_gt_pow2. Qed.

Lemma align15 : (∀ x y : int, 0%Z ≤ x → 2%Z ^ x < y → x + 1%Z ≤ len y).
Proof. exact: len_gt_pow. Qed.

Lemma align16 : (∀ x : int, 1%Z < `|x|%N → (x %% 2%Z)%Z = 0%Z → len x = len (x %/ 2%Z)%Z + 1%Z).
Proof. by move⇒ x; move: (@len_div2_neg x); rewrite abs_aligns. Qed.

Lemma align17 : (∀ x y : int, 0%Z ≤ x → 0%Z < y ∧ y < 2%Z ^ x → len y < x + 1%Z).
Proof. exact: len_gt. Qed.

Lemma align18 : (∀ x y : int, 0%Z ≤ x → 0%Z < y ∧ y ≤ 2%Z ^ x → len y ≤ x + 1%Z).
Proof. exact: len_gt'. Qed.

Lemma align19 : (∀ x k : int, 1%Z ≤ k → x < 0%Z ∧ - 2%Z ^ k < x → len x ≤ k).
Proof. exact: len_gt_pow2_neg. Qed.

Lemma align20 : (∀ x k : int, 0%Z < k → `|x|%N%:Z < 2 ^ k → `|len x|%N%:Z ≤ k).
Proof. by move⇒ x y; move: (@len_b x y); rewrite !abs_aligns. Qed.

Lemma align21 : (∀ x : int, 0%Z < x → x < 2 ^ `|len x|%N).
Proof. by move⇒ x; move: (@len_up x); rewrite abs_aligns. Qed.

Lemma align22 : (∀ x : int, x != 0%Z → 0%Z < len x).
Proof. move⇒ x /neqP; apply len_gt0. Qed.

Lemma align23 : (∀ x y : int, 0%Z < x → 0%Z < y → len `|x|%N < len `|y|%N → x < y).
Proof. by move⇒ x y; move: (@len_lt x y); rewrite !abs_aligns. Qed.

Lemma align24 : (∀ x : int, `|len x|%N%:Z = len x).
Proof. by move⇒ x; move: (abs_len x); rewrite abs_aligns. Qed.

Lemma max_aligns : ∀ (n m : nat), max n m = maxn n m.
Proof.
rewrite -maxEnat⇒ n m.
rewrite Order.POrderTheory.maxEle.
move: (max'def n m)=> [].
case: ifP⇒ [nlem → | /= nlemN _ ->]//.
by unfold not; rewrite lez_nat -pornin_gcd.leo_nat nlemN.
Qed.

Lemma n_to_nat : ∃ (nn : nat), Posz nn = N.
Proof.
rewrite /N -[len a]align24 -[len b]align24.
case: k_to_nat⇒ kn kneq.
rewrite -!kneq -!PoszM !max_aligns.
by ∃ (maxn `|len a| (maxn `|len b| (2 × kn))).
Qed.

Lemma iter_aligns (A : Type) (n : nat) (f : A → A) t : iter n f t = ssrnat.iter n f t.
Proof.
  have iterE := iter'def f t.
  elim: n⇒ [| n' IHn].
  - by case: (iterE 0)=> // /(_ erefl) →.
  - have side : 0%Z ≤ n'.+1 by rewrite lez_nat leq0n.
    case: (iterE n'.+1)=> // _ → //=.
    by rewrite -addn1 PoszD addrK IHn.
Qed.

Lemma len_aligns x : len x = pornin_gcd.ℓ len x.
Proof.
rewrite -pornin_gcd.len_ℓ //.
by move⇒ {}x; move: (len'spec x); case: (len x).
Qed.

Definition aligned_inner_dec :=
  @pornin_gcd.inner_dec len
    align1 align3 align4 align5
    align7 align8 align9 align10 align11
    align14
    align20 align21 align22 align23 align24.

Definition init_ba := pornin_gcd.approx a `|k| `|N|.
Definition init_bb := pornin_gcd.approx b `|k| `|N|.
Definition init_ba_w := approx a (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%Z × k))) k.
Definition init_bb_w := approx b (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%Z × k))) k.

Definition init := pornin_gcd.mkIter a b init_ba init_bb 1%Z 0%Z 0%Z 1%Z false false.
Definition init_w := (iter_vars'mk a b k (max (len a) (max (len b) (2%Z × k))) 1%Z init_ba_w
                           init_bb_w 1%Z 0%Z 0%Z 1%Z 1%Z 0%Z 0%Z 1%Z bu bv false false).

Definition stp (t : nat) := pornin_gcd.s_steps_s t init.
Definition stp_w (t : nat) := iter t inner_iter_fun init_w.

Lemma kgt1 (kn nn : nat) :
  (kn%:Z = k) →
  (nn%:Z = N) →
  1%Z < kn.
Proof.
move⇒ kneq nneq.
by rewrite kneq; apply Requires2.
Qed.

Lemma Nmaxn (kn nn : nat):
  kn%:Z = k → nn%:Z = N →
  nn = maxn (maxn (pornin_gcd.ℓ len (pornin_gcd.a init)) (pornin_gcd.ℓ len (pornin_gcd.b init))) (2 × kn) :> int.
Proof.
by move⇒ kneq → ; rewrite /N !len_aligns -kneq -PoszM !max_aligns // maxnA. Qed.

Lemma ic_kn (kn nn : nat) :
  kn%:Z = k → nn%:Z = N →
  pornin_gcd.init_kn len kn nn init.
Proof.
move⇒ kneq nneq.
have [eqak eqan]: kn = absz k ∧ nn = absz N.
  by rewrite -kneq -nneq !absz_nat.
split.
× apply (kgt1 kneq nneq).
× by move: (Nmaxn kneq nneq)=> [].
× by rewrite eqak eqan.
× by rewrite eqak eqan.
Qed.

Lemma boundW (i : nat) (j : int) : 0 ≤ i.+1%:Z ≤ j → 0 ≤ i%:Z ≤ j.
Proof.
move⇒ /andP[lb hb].
apply/andP; split.
by rewrite lez_nat leq0n.
apply: (leq_trans _ hb).
by rewrite lez_nat leqnSn.
Qed.

Lemma is_halving_dec vs : is_halving vs ∨ (¬ is_halving vs).
Proof.
rewrite /is_halving /is_halving'1.
set X := modz _ _.
case: (boolP (X == 0))=> [/eqP → | /neqP ]; first by left.
by right.
Qed.

Lemma lt_dec vs : is_ba_lt_bb vs ∨ (¬ is_ba_lt_bb vs).
Proof.
rewrite /is_ba_lt_bb.
case: (boolP (_ < _)); first by left.
by right.
Qed.

Lemma j_inner' vs_w :
   1%Z ≤ j' vs_w ∧ j' vs_w ≤ k' vs_w - 1%Z →

Proof.
move⇒ j_b.
move: (inner_iter_fun''def j_b)=> /= [].
case: (is_halving_dec vs_w) ⇒ [h /(_ h) → _ //| hN _ /(_ hN) ->].
have j_b2 : (0%Z ≤ j' (unset_this_iter vs_w) - 1%Z).
  by move: j_b⇒ [lb _]; rewrite j_unset lerBrDr add0r.
  move: (odd_step'def j_b2)=> /= [].
rewrite -update_swap //.
case: (lt_dec (unset_this_iter vs_w))=> [lth /(_ lth) H _ | lthN _ /(_ lthN) H].
- by rewrite odd_step_lt // j_odd_not_swap /swap/= j_update //.
rewrite odd_step_not_lt // j_odd_not_swap /swap/= j_update //.
Qed.

have : 1%Z < k. exact: Requires2.

rewrite -nneq -kneq⇒ kgt1.
move⇒ side1 side2 side3 side4.
rewrite unfold_approx //= /pornin_gcd.approx.
rewrite subzn // subzn // subzn //.
by rewrite -ltz_nat -subzn.

Lemma babb_align (i : nat):

  rewrite hN pornin_gcd.bb_odd_s ?pornin_gcd.halvingCUunset ?hN //.

  by rewrite /vs_w -iter_aligns -this_iter_lt is_ba_lt_aligns // /stp_w iter_aligns.

Lemma fgi_align (i : nat):
  0 ≤ i%:Z ≤ k - 1 →
       [/\ f0' (stp_w i) = pornin_gcd.f0 (stp i),
         f1' (stp_w i) = pornin_gcd.f1 (stp i),

have {IHi}[eqf0 eqf1 eqg0 eqg1] := IHi i'_b.

              j' (ssrnat.iter i' inner_iter_fun init_w) ≤ k' (ssrnat.iter i' inner_iter_fun init_w) - 1%Z.
  by apply j_stp_side2.
rewrite /= !inner_iter_fun'def // inc_j'spec'10 inc_j'spec'8 inc_j'spec'9 inc_j'spec'7.
move: (inner_iter_fun''def side)=> /= [].
set vs_w := unset_this_iter _.
have [eqba eqbb]:= babb_align i'_b.
have hP : is_halving vs_w ↔ pornin_gcd.is_halving (stp i').
  rewrite -is_halving_aligns; last by rewrite eqba.
  by rewrite halv_unset /stp_w iter_aligns.
case: (is_halving_dec vs_w) ⇒ [h /(_ h) → _ | hN _ /(_ hN) ->].
+ rewrite /halving_step //= eqf0 eqf1 eqg0 eqg1.
  by rewrite pornin_gcd.g0_halving -?hP // pornin_gcd.g1_halving -?hP // pornin_gcd.f0_halving -?hP // pornin_gcd.f1_halving -?hP //.
- rewrite /pornin_gcd.inner_iter pornin_gcd.halvingCUunset.
  rewrite hP in hN; move/negP/negPf : hN⇒ hN.
  rewrite hN pornin_gcd.f0_odd_s ?pornin_gcd.halvingCUunset ?hN //.
  rewrite pornin_gcd.f1_odd_s ?pornin_gcd.halvingCUunset ?hN //.
  rewrite pornin_gcd.g0_odd_s ?pornin_gcd.halvingCUunset ?hN //.
  rewrite pornin_gcd.g1_odd_s ?pornin_gcd.halvingCUunset ?hN //.
  rewrite pornin_gcd.ltCUunset.
  have ltP: pornin_gcd.is_ba_lt_bb (stp i') ↔ (is_ba_lt_bb vs_w).
    by rewrite /vs_w -iter_aligns -this_iter_lt is_ba_lt_aligns // /stp_w iter_aligns.
  have side2 : 0%Z ≤ j' vs_w - 1%Z.
    by rewrite j_unset -j_stp_side // addrK; case/andP: i'_b.

  + rewrite odd_step_not_lt //= -?ltP // ?f0_update ?g0_update ?f1_update ?g1_update /vs_w //= ?eqf0 ?eqf1 ?eqg0 ?eqg1 //.
    by apply/negP.
Qed.

Lemma formulas_align :
  ∀ (i : nat), 0 ≤ i%:Z ≤ k - 1 →
       [/\ a_t (stp_w i) = pornin_gcd.a (stp i) &

case: n_to_nat⇒ nn nneq.

  by rewrite kneq.

rewrite /stp.
move⇒ → →.

  /pornin_gcd.A /pornin_gcd.B //.
by rewrite !xt'def //.
Qed.

Theorem ebin_gcd'vc : good vars.
Proof.
  rewrite good'def; last by rewrite iter_j addrK Assert2.
  case: k_to_nat⇒ kn kneq.
  case: n_to_nat⇒ nn nneq.
  rewrite iter_a iter_b.
  pose lstep := (pornin_gcd.s_steps 0 (kn - 1) init).
  have kn_b : (0 < kn)%N.
    rewrite -ltz_nat kneq.
    by apply: (Order.PreorderTheory.lt_trans _ Requires2).
  have kb : 0 ≤ (kn - 1)%:Z ≤ k - 1.
    apply/andP; split.
    - by rewrite -subzn // kneq Assert2.
    by rewrite -subzn // kneq Order.PreorderTheory.lexx.
  have [] := @formulas_align (kn - 1) kb.
  have → : stp_w (kn - 1) = vars.
    rewrite /stp_w iter_vars1 addrK -/init_w.
      suff → : (kn - 1)%:Z = (k - 1).
      by [].
    by rewrite -subzn // kneq.
  move⇒ eqat eqbt; rewrite eqat eqbt.
  have ic : pornin_gcd.init_conditions len a b kn nn init. by apply ic0.
  have ak_neq0 : (pornin_gcd.a_t init a b (kn - 1) != 0%Z).
    have kz_b : (0%Z ≤ (kn - 1)%N%:Z ≤ kn%:Z - 1%Z).
      apply/andP; split; first by rewrite lez_nat leq0n.
      by rewrite subzn.
    have [[pow2a pow2b] [fmla fmlb]]:= @pornin_gcd.ab_invIK len kn nn init a b ic (kn - 1)%N kz_b.
    by apply /neqP; rewrite -fmla -eqat; apply H7.
  have side: 0%Z < kn.
    rewrite kneq.
    by apply: (Order.PreorderTheory.lt_trans _ Requires2).
  suff :
    pornin_gcd.good_iv len a b kn (pornin_gcd.vs_kB1 kn init)
    → len (pornin_gcd.a lstep) + len (pornin_gcd.b lstep) ≤ len a + len b - (k' vars - 1%Z).
    apply; by apply (@aligned_inner_dec kn nn)=> //.
  rewrite /pornin_gcd.good_iv.
  rewrite !len_aligns.
  rewrite /pornin_gcd.vs_kB1 /pornin_gcd.at_exit -/lstep.
  set X := pornin_gcd.ℓ _ _.
  set Y := pornin_gcd.ℓ _ _.
  set Z := pornin_gcd.ℓ _ _.
  set W := pornin_gcd.ℓ _ _.
  suff side2 : (kn - 1 ≤ Z + W)%N.
  rewrite -lez_nat !PoszD -subzn // !PoszD.
  by rewrite iter_k -subzn // kneq.
  rewrite /Z/W.
  rewrite -lez_nat -subzn // PoszD kneq.
  rewrite -!len_aligns.
  by apply Assert3; apply H6.
Qed.
